info.name: Materials Project Defect Tasks Materials Similarity API

params.name: material_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of material_id values to query on

params.name: _page
params.description: Page number to request (takes precedent over _limit and _skip).

params.name: _per_page
params.description: Number of entries to show per page (takes precedent over _limit and _skip). Limited to 1000.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip in the search.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 1000.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from SimilarityDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `builder_meta` `nsites` `elements` `nelements` `composition` `composition_reduced` `formula_pretty` `formula_anonymous` `chemsys` `volume` `density` `density_atomic` `symmetry` `material_id` `deprecated` `deprecation_reasons` `last_updated` `origins` `warnings` `structure` `property_name` `sim` `feature_vector` `method`

params.name: feature_vector_hex
params.description: A compressed, hex representation of a row unit vector of floats.

params.name: feature_vector_norm
params.description: The norm of the feature vector

params.name: method
params.description: The method used to embed a structure as a feature vector.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 10 by default
